method: 3 independent single-turn calls to the task's own configured judge model (glm-5.2), no gym access, given only instruction.md's Task section, asked to render a plausible example of the two deliverable files with invented values. what_varied_freely: JSON key order in metrics.json (all verifier checks use $.. recursive descent, not a rooted path)
Whether metrics.json is pretty-printed or compact (file_check parses the JSON tree, not the bytes)
CSV row order (csv_rows_are_right is a native rubric assertion that explicitly frees row order)
CSV quoting style / incidental whitespace around values (rubric explicitly frees this; header check reads through csv.inspect_table's parsed header list, not raw bytes)
what_is_fixed_and_confirmed_fixed_by_eve: The exact CSV header column set and order (channel_id,channel_name,retracted_message_author_id,retracted_message_author_name,stranded_reply_count)
worst_channel_id / notify_candidate_id rendered as bare strings, never wrapped in an object
